# PackagedScenes

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/Scene/PackagedScenes.cs#L18)

Unity refuses to open a scene that lives inside an installed package - "It is not allowed
to open a scene in a read-only package" - which would stop every template carrying a scene
from working the moment the framework is installed as a package instead of sitting in
Assets. The way past it is to copy the scene into the project and open the copy, which is
what this does.
Nothing here changes for a framework in Assets or in an embedded package: those scenes open
directly, and the copy never happens.

### CopyTo(string, string) {#copyto-string-string}

Copies a scene to a chosen path, replacing anything already there. Used when the copy is
the user's own scene from then on, rather than a throwaway.

### DiscardTempCopy(string) {#discardtempcopy-string}

Deletes a copy made by [`OpenablePath(string, string)`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/PackagedScenes#openablepath-string-string), and the temporary folder with it once
the last copy is gone. Any other path is left alone, so this is safe to call with
whatever [`OpenablePath(string, string)`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/PackagedScenes#openablepath-string-string) returned.

### IsReadOnly(string) {#isreadonly-string}

True when the asset sits in a package Unity treats as immutable. Embedded and local

### OpenablePath(string, string) {#openablepath-string-string}

A path for this scene that Unity will actually open. Scenes outside a read-only package
are handed straight back; ones inside get copied to `TempFolder`first, and
the caller is expected to pass the result to [`DiscardTempCopy(string)`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/PackagedScenes#discardtempcopy-string) when it is
done with it.

```csharp
public static string OpenablePath(string assetPath, string name = null)
```

**Returns** [`string`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string) - A path that can be opened, or null when the copy could not be made.
